author: Marcus R. Brown
message:
fix(deps): consolidate outstanding security overrides (#2002)

* fix(deps): consolidate outstanding security overrides

Adds overrides for three advisories that each had their own bot PR. All
three edited the same overrides block, so once the nanoid override landed
in #1904 the remaining PRs conflicted against main and against each other.
Consolidating them into one entry point avoids three sequential rebases.

- adm-zip >=0.6.0 (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85, was #1838)
- brace-expansion >=5.0.8 (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, was #1866)
- postcss >=8.5.23 (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, was #1862)

The postcss floor is raised past what #1862 proposed. That PR targeted
8.5.18, which clears the high advisory but leaves medium
GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp open; 8.5.23 closes both.

Resolves to adm-zip 0.6.0, brace-expansion 5.0.9, postcss 8.5.26.

* fix(deps): narrow brace-expansion override to per-major floors

The consolidated override forced brace-expansion onto v5 for every
consumer, but the maintainer backports fixes per major line and both
resolutions already in the tree were above their respective patched
floors. Scope the override to the two affected lines instead.

- brace-expansion@1.x -> ^1.1.17 (resolves 1.1.18)
- brace-expansion@2.x -> ^2.1.3 (resolves 2.1.4)

brace-expansion 5.0.9 remains untouched: it is an independent transitive
request via @storybook/test-runner -> jest-config and already sits above
the advisory floor.

---------

Co-authored-by: Marcus R. Brown <contact@mrbro.dev>

author: Marcus R. Brown
message:
fix(ci): enable authenticated git push for Fro Bot autoheal runs (#2001)

Scheduled autoheal runs had no pushable git remote, so every fix the
agent produced degraded to working-dir mode and had nowhere to land.
The checkout step uses persist-credentials: false to keep the PAT out of
.git/config on the fork-PR-head comment path, but nothing restored a
credential for the paths that legitimately need to push.

Write the PAT to http.https://github.com/.extraheader after checkout,
gated to the 05:00 autoheal cron and dispatched autoheal runs. The 17:00
maintenance cron is excluded because its prompt forbids opening PRs, and
mention runs are excluded because the agent fails closed when it finds an
on-disk extraheader on a credential-withheld path.

Ports the pattern already running in marcusrbrown/mrbro.dev, with tighter
cron-level scoping since this repo runs autoheal and maintenance on
separate schedules.

Co-authored-by: Marcus R. Brown <contact@mrbro.dev>

author: Fro Bot
message:
fix(theme): correct spacing scale consistency check for zero-anchored scales (#1841)

The geometric-progression check used a truthy guard (`prevValue && ...`)
to skip windows before computing ratios, which silently skipped any
window anchored on a spacing value of 0 (a common baseline). Combined
with a loose 0.5 tolerance, this caused `theme-validator.test.ts` >
'should treat warnings as errors in strict mode' to fail: no warning
was produced for an intentionally inconsistent scale.

Switch to explicit undefined/zero checks so 0-anchored windows are
skipped for the right reason (avoiding division by zero) rather than
by accident, and tighten the ratio tolerance from 0.5 to 0.3 so a
2.5x/2x jump is correctly flagged as inconsistent.

Fixes the previously-failing `pnpm test` run for @sparkle/theme;
all 164 tests now pass.

Co-authored-by: Marcus R. Brown <git@mrbro.dev>

Adds the missing workspace:* devDependency and regenerates the
lockfile. Verified pnpm check/build/test all green (17/17 test files,
445 passed/1 skipped).

author: Fro Bot
message:
chore(lint): apply auto-fixes from autohealing run (#1787)

* fix(turbo): add missing build:<package> script aliases

Turborepo's task graph references package-qualified tasks like
@sparkle/ui#build:ui and @sparkle/config#build:config as dependencies
of the test, dev, docs:automation, and build:docs tasks. Most packages
never defined a script matching these task names (only @sparkle/theme
did, via build:theme), so Turborepo silently no-ops those dependency
edges instead of erroring.

The most visible symptom: pnpm test's ^build:ui dependency never ran
packages/ui's build:css step, so packages/ui/dist/styles.css was
missing on a clean checkout and moo-dang's component tests failed
with 'Failed to resolve import "./styles.css"'.

Add build:<package> aliases (matching the existing build:theme
convention) to types, utils, error-testing, config, ui, storybook,
docs, and moo-dang so the turbo.json task graph resolves as intended
on a clean checkout without requiring a prior full 'pnpm build'.

Verified: removed all dist/ and .turbo/ output and confirmed
'pnpm test' now builds dependencies correctly and all 445 tests pass.

* fix(moo-dang): add missing @sparkle/test-utils dependency

Test files in apps/moo-dang/src/{components,shell}/*.test.{ts,tsx}
import from @sparkle/test-utils subpaths (./console, ./dom, ./react,
./terminal), but the package was never declared as a devDependency in
apps/moo-dang/package.json. Turborepo's ^build dependency graph builds
@sparkle/test-utils before running tests, masking the issue in CI
(dist/ existed), but pnpm never created the node_modules symlink,
so 3 test files (Terminal.test.tsx, wasm.test.ts,
wasm-integration.test.ts) failed with unresolved imports on a clean
install.

Verified: pnpm test now passes 445/446 (1 skipped) across all 17
moo-dang test files and the full monorepo.

* fix(deps): repair pnpm-lock.yaml after merge with main

message:
fix(deps): update dependency astro to v7 [SECURITY] (#1847)

* fix(deps): update dependency astro to v7 [SECURITY]

* fix(docs): coordinate Astro v7 upgrade with MDX/Starlight majors

The astro@7 security bump left @astrojs/mdx@5.0.6 and
@astrojs/starlight@0.38.5 pinned to peer astro@^6.0.0, which fails
the docs build (astro package.json exports no longer expose
./jsx/rehype.js expected by the stale mdx integration).

Bump @astrojs/mdx to ^7.0.0 and @astrojs/starlight to ^0.41.0 to
match the astro v7 peer requirement.

Starlight v0.39 removed support for autogenerate sidebar groups with
a label; migrate the 5 API Reference sidebar groups to the new
{label, items: [{autogenerate}]} shape per the upstream migration
guide.

Verified: pnpm build (10/10 tasks incl. @sparkle/docs#build), pnpm
check (clean), pnpm test (445 passed/1 skipped).

author: Fro Bot
message:
fix(ci): use explicit path patterns in regenerate-docs path filter (#1798)

GitHub Actions push.paths filters only support `*`/`**` glob wildcards,
not brace expansion (e.g. `*.{ts,tsx}`). The regenerate-docs.yaml
push trigger used brace-expanded extension groups, which GitHub never
matches — the workflow has 0 recorded runs since it was added, despite
many qualifying commits to packages/*/src/**.

Expand each brace group into its own explicit path entry so the
push trigger actually fires on source changes to ui/types/utils/theme/
error-testing packages.

Also regenerate the drifted API doc this caused: token-transformer's
mergeThemes signature already takes Partial<ThemeConfig>, but the
generated docs still showed the pre-change ThemeConfig type.

🤖 Fixed by the Fro Bot daily autohealing run.

author: Marcus R. Brown
message:
fix(fro-bot): honor a bare workflow_dispatch prompt regardless of mode (#1796)

A dispatched prompt was only consumed when mode was 'review'. Since
mode defaults to 'autoheal', any workflow_dispatch that passed only a
custom prompt (no mode) fell through to the autoheal prompt and the
custom prompt was silently discarded. Let a non-empty inputs.prompt win
first for any workflow_dispatch, matching how the sibling repos wire
their prompt selection; mode-based maintenance/autoheal fallbacks still
apply when no prompt is supplied.

message:
fix(deps): update pnpm to v11 [SECURITY] (#1773)

* fix(deps): update pnpm to v11 [SECURITY]

* fix(deps): add pnpm v11 allowBuilds map for onlyBuiltDependencies

pnpm v11 requires an explicit allowBuilds map in addition to
onlyBuiltDependencies to permit build scripts for allowlisted
dependencies. Without it, install fails with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS
even though the packages are already listed under
onlyBuiltDependencies.

Verified: pnpm install, pnpm check, pnpm build, and pnpm test all
pass cleanly under pnpm@11.5.3 with this change.

author: Marcus R. Brown
message:
feat(ci): add Fro Bot workflow + llms.txt project map (#1662)

Brings sparkle to agent-native parity with marcusrbrown/marcusrbrown and
mrbro.dev. Unified workflow template handles PR review, scheduled
maintenance, and autohealing in one file.

## .github/workflows/fro-bot.yaml

- Triggers: PR open/sync/reopen/ready/review_requested, issue
  open/edit, @fro-bot mention in issue/PR/discussion comments,
  schedule, workflow_dispatch (with mode selector)
- Schedule: 05:00 UTC autoheal, 17:00 UTC maintenance
  (staggered off marcusrbrown 04:30/16:30 and mrbro.dev 03:30/15:30)
- Author/event guards: skip bot authors and forks, require
  OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR for comment triggers, refuse fork PR
  heads on issue_comment-triggered checkouts
- Uses sparkle's existing ./.github/actions/setup-ci composite
  with install-zig: true for moo-dang
- Pinned: fro-bot/agent@v0.44.3, actions/checkout@v6.0.2
- Sunday UTC detection for category 8 (Upstream Modernization Watch)

## Prompts (sparkle-tailored)

- PR_REVIEW_PROMPT — TS monorepo focus (Turborepo task graph,
  workspace:* protocol, ESM-only, cross-package side effects, theme
  system tokens, visual regression coverage, WASM/Zig boundary)
- MAINTENANCE_PROMPT — perpetual 'Daily Maintenance Report' issue
  with sparkle-specific metrics (Renovate dashboard, abandoned-deps
  count, docs site freshness, deploy-docs run health)
- AUTOHEAL_PROMPT — 8 categories: errored PRs, security, code
  quality (pnpm check/lint/test/check:monorepo/health-check),
  developer experience, quality gates (incl. docs build + build
  pipeline), live docs site validation via agent-browser against
  sparkle.mrbro.dev, cross-project intelligence, Sunday-only
  upstream modernization watch
- Trusted bot authors: renovate, dependabot, mrbro-bot, fro-bot
- Hard boundaries preserved: no force-push, no default-branch
  pushes, no merging, no weakening of guardrails

## llms.txt (new)

Compact project map for agent runtime context: workspace layout,
package purposes, key scripts, build pipeline, workflows, public
surface, and a conventions quick-reference. Points at
.github/copilot-instructions.md as the authoritative deep source.

## Secrets / vars

Pre-provisioned via 'infra cliproxy setup --harness opencode --repo
marcusrbrown/sparkle':
- secrets: FRO_BOT_PAT, OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON, OMO_PROVIDERS,
  OPENCODE_CONFIG
- vars: FRO_BOT_MODEL

## Verification

- actionlint .github/workflows/fro-bot.yaml — exit 0
- setup-ci invocation matches main.yaml and deploy-docs.yaml usage
- Schedule slot does not collide with sibling repos

message:
feat: add new cursor rules and documentation for best practices (#605)

* feat: add new cursor rules and documentation for best practices

- Introduced new rules for cursor configuration, including guidelines for TypeScript, Expo, Storybook, and Tailwind CSS integration.
- Added comprehensive documentation outlining best practices for Sparkle development, including project structure, package management, and testing strategies.
- Removed outdated rules related to Storybook and Turbo best practices, consolidating them into the new documentation.
- Updated .gitignore and markdownlint configuration to accommodate new files and rules.

* chore: update documentation and configuration

- Added `.specstory/` to `.prettierignore` to exclude Storybook specification files from formatting.
- Improved formatting and consistency in `best-practices-for-sparkle-development.md` and `project-guide.md` by adjusting list formatting and code snippets for better readability.
- Ensured that all code examples in the documentation follow a consistent style.
